panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: CT scan displays an axial non-contrast bone window image of a 35-year-old male, showing a transverse fracture of the right petrous temporal bone which is noted to involve the otic capsule and the right internal carotid artery (ICA). This is a clear presentation of an otic capsule violating temporal bone fracture. B: CT scan displays an axial non-contrast bone window image of a 35-year-old male, showing a transverse fracture of the right petrous temporal bone involving the jugular fossa walls. The fracture is described as otic capsule violating.
